## Synopsis for "Force of Arms"

Reprint of the 1st story from   
[Amazing Spider-Man #296](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Amazing_Spider-Man_Vol_1_296 "Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 296")

Having run out of web-fluid while on patrol, [Spider-Man](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Peter_Parker_(Earth-616) "Peter Parker (Earth-616)") is reduced to walking home in the middle of a summer storm. As he bounds his way home on the rooftops, Spider-Man considers the idea of upgrading his web-shooters so they have a warning indicator to tell him when he is running out of web-fluid so this situation doesn't happen again. When the wall-crawler finally gets home, he gets out of his costume and takes a shower. With his body aching, Peter wishes his wife [Mary Jane](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Mary_Jane_Watson_(Earth-616) "Mary Jane Watson (Earth-616)") was home instead of at a modeling gig so she could look after him.[[Continuity 1]](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Astonishing_Spider-Man_Vol_3_16#cite_note-1) Making himself some tea, Peter begins thinking about how he can redesign his web-shooters. One concern is traveling by plane because of metal detectors.[[Continuity 2]](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Astonishing_Spider-Man_Vol_3_16#cite_note-2) As he thinks over possible designs, he falls asleep from exhaustion.
